title: Cascaded Metasurface Interferometer for Multipath Interference with Classical and Quantum Light
summary: Beamsplitters represent fundamental components in both classical and quantum optical systems, enabling the distribution of light, as well as the generation of interference, superposition and entanglement. However, optical networks constructed from conventional bulk 2x2-beamsplitters encounter inherent scalability issues, as the number of required beamsplitters scales quadratically with the number of optical modes for a fully connected network.
